items.html: And therefore there was in them also another difference, in these Mochin of Hochma and Bina of the pregnancy, from the Mochin of Hochma and Bina of the nursing. For even though all of them are Names of Elokim, as above, nevertheless these Elokim were not all revealed completely, except for three of their letters, namely Aleph-Lamed-Mem of Elokim; but the two letters Yod-Hei of Elokim were not yet revealed in it.
